Remark
[Gauss lemma and the radial Laplacian] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0240 1. ch23:23.6\group Parametrix

The Gauss lemma gives $x^i=\sum _jx^jg_{ji}$ and, for a radial function $f(r)$, \[ \Delta _xf=f''+\left(\frac{n-1}{r}+\partial _r\log \alpha \right)f'. \] Consequently \[ (\Delta _x-\partial _t)E=-\frac r{2(t-u)}(\partial _r\log \alpha )E. \]
